text: よくきたな　＊も　＊も　とっても　げんきじゃぞ

structure.jp: とっても　げんきじゃぞ

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the way old people in stories say だ, 'is'. げんきじゃ = 'is doing well'.

patterns.name: 〜も〜も
patterns.explanation: も after two things in a row means 'both this and that'. ＊も　＊も = 'both ＊ and ＊'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end pushes the statement at the listener in a rough, confident way. げんきじゃぞ = 'they're doing well, I tell you'.
